lessons.title: Introduction to generative AI
lessons.objective: LLM concepts and the Java AI ecosystem.

keys: Provision models as code: Bicep + azd, repeatable by decree
Keyless auth with Entra ID — no API keys in config, ever
Docker/Codespaces make the environment the deliverable

lessons.title: Core generative AI techniques
keys: Prompt engineering transfers as-is to the JVM
Vector similarity: embeddings in, nearest neighbors out
Function calling: Spring beans the model can invoke

lessons.objective: Ship the samples: pet stories, local models, MCP calculator.
keys: Pet story generator: creative completion end to end
Foundry Local: models on your machine, OpenAI SDK compatible
MCP calculator with Spring AI — the protocol speaks Java

lessons.title: Responsible AI development
keys: Content safety: hard blocks vs soft refusals — know which fired
Test the guardrails, don't assume them
Deploy with the same engineering discipline as any service
